issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Book.author is a String, and the Client/assembly code in the solution constructs Book instances using String authors. However, in the solution repository the Book struct declares author as a Bool (solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift lines 24-33). This creates an internal contradiction in the solution (the Client creates Book instances with String authors) and a mismatch with the problem specification, causing compilation errors and confusion about the intended type for the author field.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the type of the Book.author property to String in the implementation (solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift) so it matches the problem statement and the Client code that constructs and prints authors. Ensure the template implementation and any example usages also use String for the author field.
